scope: Read-only measurements; source timing/content unchanged. Thresholded near-silence is not exact silence. Exact signed8 zero gaps can be omitted only if playback emits the identical zero samples for the identical duration.
threshold_definition: Tail continues only while both native floating-point channels have absolute amplitude<=threshold. Per-channel counts also included.
storage_estimate_note: Sparse-gap estimates assume16-byte metadata per omitted stereo gap and retain the original8192-sample/channel guard plus64KiB player budget. They do not include a new scheduler/decompressor implementation.

conclusion: All8 full target PCM streams are stored individually within32MiB at65536stereo except Timeless. Timeless has only55.34ms of exact quantized-zero tail; practical long-zero omission alone is insufficient. Unaligned16-frame sparse gaps barely fit an abstract budget, but16-sample-aligned gaps do not under64KiB player overhead. Lossless block/partial compression, lower effective storage rate or segmentation can retain complete playback duration.
